MARACAY, Venezuela, Nov 26 (Reuters) – Workers at Venezuela’s Amuay refinery evacuated on Thursday due to a fire in a trench containing residual products, although the blaze was extinguished with no injuries reported, according to five workers at state oil company PDVSA.

One worker said the incident led to the temporary shutdown of Distillation Unit 1, the only currently operational unit at Amuay, the largest refinery in the country and part of the Paraguana Refining Center in northwestern Venezuela.

 PDVSA, which owns Amuay, confirmed in a statement that the fire was put out without causing injuries. It added the incident did not affect domestic fuel distribution. It did not address the status of the distillation unit or the cause of the fire. 

Show Full Article

Another worker said the fire began in a naphtha pipeline when leaked fuel ignited, setting fire to a truck and other vehicles.

Fires and power outages are frequent at PDVSA refineries, which are in dilapidated condition and operate at a fraction of capacity.

Amuay has a processing capacity of 645,000 barrels per day but is currently processing only 67,000 barrels per day.

(Reporting by Mircely Guanipa in Maracay and Deisy Buitrago in Caracas, writing by Paolo Laudani, Editing by Natalia Siniawski and Daina Beth Solomon)

Saudi-led coalition says Houthis attacked Aramco's Jazan refinery

The coalition warned of a strong military response to further Houthi attacks on civilian targets and infrastructure.

Smoke rises from a fire at the Aramco refinery south of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Oct 3, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Stringer)

RIYADH: The Saudi - led military coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis said on Thursday (Nov 26) that the Iran-aligned group had attacked Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery, a day after hitting the largest oil refinery in the kingdom.
The refinery in the southwestern city of Jazan, near the Yemeni border, is designed to process up to 400,000 barrels of crude oil per day.
The coalition said it had later destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in the Yemeni port city of Hodeidah, which it said the Houthis had used in Thursday's attack on the refinery.
Earlier it said that targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure would be met with a firm military response.

On Wednesday the Houthis claimed attacks on Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia's largest refinery and a major crude export hub, and the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Jazan.
The Saudi - led coalition said it had intercepted four drones over Ras Tanura and air defences had destroyed a drone near Jeddah Islamic Port.
The Houthis , who control the most populous areas of Yemen including the capital Sanaa, have launched missiles and drones at Saudi airports, oil facilities and office buildings since Yemen's civil war reignited in July, in a spillover from the US-Iran war.
The attacks have previously temporarily disrupted some of Aramco's operations and caused the cancellation of most international flights to Riyadh. They also forced Saudi Arabia to postpone or cancel major international events, including soccer's AFC Asian Cup and the flagship FII investment conference.
Fighting has intensified since the Houthis seized strategic territory along Yemen's Red Sea coast in September and advanced towards the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a vital shipping route for Gulf oil producers seeking access to the Red Sea.

items.title: Thanksgiving Storm Sweeps East Coast, Delays Macy’s Parade
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: A powerful Thanksgiving storm is sweeping up the US East Coast toward New York, as adverse weather knocks out power to more than half a million homes and businesses across the nation while snarling holiday travel.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- A powerful Thanksgiving storm is sweeping up the US East Coast toward New York, as adverse weather knocks out power to more than half a million homes and businesses across the nation while snarling holiday travel.The strengthening storm has already led to the postponement of events including Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade, which has been rescheduled for Saturday, marking the first time the annual holiday procession has been delayed. The governors of New York and New Jersey both declared a state of emergency, warning of damaging winds, heavy rainfall and severe coastal flooding through Friday.The conditions complicate journeys for those heading to family gatherings, though the days leading up to Thanksgiving tend to see greater travel than the holiday itself. AccuWeather meteorologist Alyssa Glenny said wind gusts have already reached 72 miles per hour at Stingray Point, Virginia, with coastal areas of New Jersey and Long Island bracing for gusts up to 80 mph as the storm pushes northward.“We’re looking at the afternoon going into the evening for peak rainfall in New York,” Glenny said via telephone. “Once we get to midday, early afternoon, the wind is going to pick up and then the next 12 hours is the window for peak winds.”The National Weather Service has issued coastal flood warnings for various New York and New Jersey counties, encompassing all five boroughs of New York City. In a statement, Mayor Zohran Mamdani urged the city’s residents to use caution if traveling. There were also about 400 reported flight cancellations across the US, with Baltimore/Washington International Airport and New York’s John F. Kennedy International Airport among the most impacted, according to FlightAware data. While elevated, the disruption is far below the levels recorded earlier this month after the US Federal Aviation Administration imposed a nationwide ground stop due to an equipment outage.Meanwhile, there are over 668,000 US power outages as of about 1 p.m. Eastern Time, according to PowerOutage.com. That includes about 5% of customers in Maryland, Virginia and Missouri, with the latter enduring heavy snowfall from a winter storm. “With the power outages, we always are concerned with downed trees that could impact travel,” AccuWeather’s Glenny said. “Along the coastal areas — like those locations in Southern New Jersey, Ocean City, Maryland where they’re having the coastal flooding — there are definitely some travel impacts with flooded roadways in that corridor.”The Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed due to the high winds making it too dangerous to send the balloons above the streets of Manhattan. The city adopted new wind rules after the 1997 Thanksgiving parade, when gusts hurled a gigantic Cat in the Hat balloon into a lamppost, injuring spectators.“The safety of our participants and spectators is our top priority, and after close consultation with our city and agency partners, we have made the decision to move this year’s celebration,” Macy’s said in a statement. The balloons have been grounded because of weather just once in the parade’s history, in 1971, while in 2019 they were required to fly at lower heights because of high winds. This year’s rescheduled event is due to start at 8:30 a.m. in New York on Saturday. “Tomorrow we’re going to start to see the impacts winding down and then we’re kind of just dealing with cleanup,” said Glenny. “By Saturday, for places like New York City, we expect a dry day. By the afternoon we could even have some breaks of sun.”(Updates with latest data throughout; adds detail on flooding in fifth paragraph, timing of Macy’s parade in penultimate paragraph.)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.body:
News

Mastercard Stocks Rise 1.94% as Payment Networks Gain in AI Selloff Rotation Less than 1 min read

MA
Mastercard MA shares rose 1.94% to $659.97 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 25, as investors moved out of AI hardware and into steadier earners. Visa gained 1.8% and American Express rose 1.2% on a day when the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.62% after dropping as much as 4.6% intraday.
The rotation favored businesses tied to consumer spending volumes rather than data center budgets. Mastercard set a record close of $672.68 on November 4 after a 10% weekly run that followed its third-quarter report, TIKR reported at the time. Wednesday's close leaves shares 1.9% below that peak. The same session brought hotter October inflation data, with core PCE prices up 3.3% from a year earlier; higher prices tend to lift nominal card volumes, a mild tailwind for network revenue.

Mastercard's appeal in this tape is predictability: transaction fees with little capex, against an AI complex burning cash. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 98/100, with elite profitability and strong momentum, offset only by a more moderate balance sheet ranking. GF Value of $705.27 implies a 6.4% discount and a "fairly valued" label, so the shares are a quality refuge rather than a bargain. The next test is holiday spending data after Black Friday, which will show whether cross-border and domestic volumes keep supporting the premium.

Trump uses Thanksgiving message to lash out at political foes, immigrants, federal government

27 November, 2026 12:00 am IST

Nov 26 (Reuters) – As American families gathered to celebrate one of the biggest holidays of the year, US President Donald Trump on Thursday used the occasion of Thanksgiving to attack liberals, immigrants and a federal agency.

In a message on his Truth Social platform, Trump offered holiday greetings to people he accused of fraud, error or criminality.

“I would like to wish a very Happy Thanksgiving to all of those people that have worked so hard to bring our Country to the Radical Far Left,” Trump said in the 461-word post.

Show Full Article

The message was issued while the Republican president spent the family-oriented holiday at his Trump International Golf Club in West Palm Beach, Florida. He was expected to call US service members later on Thursday from his Mar-a-Lago estate.

In the holiday greeting, Trump accused his own government of falsifying US economic data. He warned of efforts by unnamed people to implement Muslim religious law and forcibly redistribute private property. He also described large numbers of US immigrants and people of Somali descent as jobless or criminal.

Trump offered no evidence for any of the claims, some of which repeated longtime talking points. The US Commerce Department’s Bureau of Economic Analysis did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

The US president also defended his White House renovation projects, saying reporters and citizens had misunderstood them.

Trump’s Republican Party suffered heavy losses in the November 3 midterm elections and will cede control of both chambers of Congress in January.

(Reporting by Reuters Washington bureau; Editing by Sergio Non and Bill Berkrot)

PARIS, Nov 26 : Algeria's Imane Khelif will make her first appearance since winning Olympic gold at the Paris Games when she faces France's Elsa Hemat in Paris on December 15, promoter Stair Event told Reuters on Thursday.
Khelif has not competed in an official event since claiming women's welterweight gold at the 2024 Olympics amid a gender dispute over her eligibility.
The 27-year-old had been due to face 21-year-old Dutch boxer Clarida Sarabia in a six-round professional bout, but Sarabia withdrew for what promoter Stair Event called "administrative reasons".
Hemat, 44, was subsequently named as her replacement.
In February, Khelif said she was open to genetic testing only if administered by the International Olympic Committee.

items.body:
＜外為市場＞　

米国の感謝祭で薄商いとなる中、ドル高が一服し、今年の高値をやや下回る水準で推移した。世界の株式市場が反発し、安全資産への逃避の動きが和らいだ。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は一進一退の動きを見せた後、終盤では横ばいの１０３．７０と、２０２５年３月以来の高値をわずかに下回る水準となった。

円は対ドルでほぼ横ばいの１５９．２０付近で推移した。

ユーロも横ばいの１．０９８ドルで推移。今週初めに２０２５年４月以来の安値まで下落した後、３日続伸に向かう勢い。

ただ、短期的に重要な節目である１．１２ドルを回復するのは難しいとサンタンデールＡＭのシニアストラテジスト、トマス・ガルシアプリニョス氏は指摘。新たなレンジが１．０７ドルから１．１２ドルの間で形成されつつあると述べた。

ポンドは小幅低下の１．３１１ドル。直近１６営業日のうち１３営業日で下落し、月間ベースでは対ドルで２％超下落している。

スイスフランは対ドルで０．４％安の１ドル＝０．８３４１フラン。前日は安全資産への需要から０．５％上昇していた。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。鉱業株や大手銀行株に支えられ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は１．８％、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種は１．９％、それぞれ上昇した。

銀行株が最大の押し上げ要因となり、ＨＳＢＣが２．３％高、スタンダードチャータードが１．３％高、ライオン・ファイナンス・グループが４．２％高となった。

銅価格の反発を受け、非鉄金属の鉱業株は２．８％上昇した。

たばこ大手インペリアル・ブランズは１３．３％急伸し、１日の上昇率として過去最大を記録。９年超ぶりの高値を付けた。米たばこ大手アルトリアが同社に対する全額現金による買収提案を検討していると表明し、同社事業の一部を巡って別の相手と協議していると明らかにしたことが材料視された。

その他の個別銘柄では、防衛企業バブコックが６．５％高。英国は原子力潜水艦関連施設の改修に向け、同社と８０億ポンド（１０４億８０００万ドル）の契約を結んだ。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

大幅に上昇して取引を終えた。米国が欧州連合（ＥＵ）に課す予定の関税が懸念されたほど厳しくならないとの期待から、幅広い銘柄が買われた。

市場はまた、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の次期総裁にスペイン出身のデコス氏（５５）が就任する見通しとなったことについて、ＥＣＢの現行政策が継続される兆しと受け止めた。nL6N4770V2

ドイツ、スペイン、イタリアの主要株価指数はいずれも２％超上昇した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ６００種の主要業種別指数は全て上昇した。鉱業株指数、自動車株指数、防衛株指数はいずれも３％超上昇した。

シーメンス・エナジーは４．８％上昇した。

一方、コメルツ銀行は２．６％下落。イタリアのウニクレディトが同行の経営陣刷新を計画していると明らかにした。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

域内国債利回りが４日連続低下から反転して上昇した。世界的な株式相場の回復と原油価格の上昇を受け、安全資産への需要が後退した。

この日の株式相場は反発した。米国が提案した新たな関税措置が当初懸念されたほど打撃にならないとの見方が広がったほか、感謝祭に伴う連休が、ここ最近苦戦していた人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄の取引に一服感をもたらした。

こうした中、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の首脳は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の次期総裁に前スペイン中銀総裁のパブロ・エルナンデス・デコス氏を充てる人事を承認する見通しとなった。ただ、市場の反応は限定的だった。アナリストらは、インフレへの注視とコンセンサスに基づく意思決定が今後も続くと指摘している。

ＡＩを巡る懸念で株式市場が急落したことを受け、ＥＣＢの利上げ観測はやや後退している。短期金融市場は、現在２．５％のＥＣＢの中銀預金金利が２０２７年終盤までに３．１％へ上昇するとの見方を織り込んでいる。先週終盤時点では約３．２５％と予想していた。

ドイツ１０年債利回りは５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．２６６％。前日には１１月２２日以来の低水準となる３．２０８１％を付けていた。

ドイツ２年債利回りは６ｂｐ上昇の３．０７９％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４９ｂｐに小幅縮小した。

こうした中、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の首脳は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の次期総裁に前スペイン中銀総裁のパブロ・エルナンデス・デコス氏を充てる人事を承認する見通しとなった。ただ、市場の反応は限定的だった。アナリストらは、インフレへの注視とコンセンサスに基づく意思決定が今後も続くと指摘している。

ＡＩを巡る懸念で株式市場が急落したことを受け、ＥＣＢの利上げ観測はやや後退している。短期金融市場は、現在２．５％のＥＣＢの中銀預金金利が２０２７年終盤までに３．１％へ上昇するとの見方を織り込んでいる。先週終盤時点では約３．２５％と予想していた。

ドイツ１０年債利回りは５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．２６６％。前日には１１月２２日以来の低水準となる３．２０８１％を付けていた。

ドイツ２年債利回りは６ｂｐ上昇の３．０７９％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４９ｂｐに小幅縮小した。

ROME: Two Italians were killed in a drone attack in Kuwait on Thursday (Nov 26) that Italy and Kuwait blamed on Iran, although Tehran has denied any involvement.
The two were technicians working for Rheinmetall Italia, the Italian unit of German defence group Rheinmetall, and were at an air defence surveillance station in Kuwait when it was targeted by Iranian drones, Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani told the Senate in Rome.
"Following a powerful explosion, both of our compatriots, according to information coming from Kuwait , have died. Two other people were injured: a Pakistani national and a captain in the Kuwait i army," Tajani said.
Kuwait 's Defence Ministry confirmed that the two Italians had died of their injuries, after initially reporting that four people had been wounded by falling debris when a "vital facility" was targeted in what it said was an Iranian attack. It said the other two injured were Kuwait i and Pakistani nationals and that the attack had caused material damage.

Iran's senior Armed Forces spokesperson Abolfazl Shekarchi denied that Iran had attacked a "vital" site in Kuwait , saying no offensive or military operations by Iranian forces had taken place in the region, Iranian state media reported on Thursday.
Iran's embassy in Rome also categorically denied the claims of an Iranian drone attack on a military site in Kuwait in a post on X.
Tajani told Italian news agency AGI that Italy would lodge a complaint with the Iranian embassy over the incident, urging caution and saying there was no need to attack Arab countries bordering Iran that were not involved in the war.
The regional conflict erupted on Feb 28 when the US and Israeli launched attacks on Iran, and it has since widened to include Iranian strikes on Israel and Gulf Arab states hosting US military bases.
Earlier in November, Iran said it had targeted US drone and missile sites in Kuwait after the United States struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Mexico Urges Asian Trade Partners to Crack Down on Chinese Goods’ Tariff Evasion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Mexico has urged its Asian trade partners to strengthen controls against tariff evasion and the illegal rerouting of goods, as pressure from the United States intensifies over the role of Chinese products and components in North American supply chains. Economy Minister Marcelo Ebrard made the …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
Mexico has urged its Asian trade partners to strengthen controls against tariff evasion and the illegal rerouting of goods, as pressure from the United States intensifies over the role of Chinese products and components in North American supply chains.

Economy Minister Marcelo Ebrard made the appeal on Thursday at a meeting of Pacific Rim trade ministers in Vietnam, calling for stronger enforcement of rules that determine where products are manufactured and whether they qualify for preferential tariff treatment.

The move reflects Mexico’s efforts to address U.S. concerns that Chinese goods could enter the North American market through third countries, allowing exporters to circumvent tariffs and trade restrictions by declaring a different country of origin.

“We are not going to weaken our treaties or the rules that we ourselves established, for example, regarding transshipment or other practices,” Ebrard said.

The issue has become increasingly important as Washington and Mexico negotiate the future of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), with the Trump administration pushing for stricter regional-content requirements for goods manufactured in North America.

Washington Targets Chinese Components in North American Supply Chains

U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said in July that Washington wanted tougher rules requiring vehicles manufactured in North America to contain more regional components and fewer parts sourced from Asia.

The United States also wants stricter origin requirements for products including electronics and pharmaceuticals, according to Reuters.

The proposals reflect Washington’s broader concern about China’s growing role in global manufacturing and the possibility that Chinese companies could use Mexico as a production or distribution base to access the U.S. market under preferential trade arrangements.

For Mexico, the challenge is to maintain its position as a major manufacturing and export hub for the United States while demonstrating that its trade agreements are not being used to circumvent tariffs on Chinese products.

Ebrard said countries needed to improve the traceability of goods to establish where products were actually manufactured and prevent illegal transshipment.

Transshipment is not inherently illegal. It becomes tariff evasion when goods are routed through another country or their origin is misrepresented to obtain preferential tariff treatment or avoid applicable duties without meeting the relevant rules.

The distinction is particularly important for Chinese manufacturers operating across Asia and North America, where production increasingly involves components and intermediate goods sourced from multiple countries.

A product containing Chinese components does not automatically qualify as Chinese-origin under every trade agreement. Its eligibility depends on the applicable product-specific rules of origin, including requirements for substantial transformation or regional value content.

Mexico Raises Tariffs on Chinese Imports

Mexico has already increased import duties on a broad range of products from countries with which it does not have free-trade agreements, including China, as part of efforts to protect domestic manufacturers and address concerns about import competition.

The tariff increases, which took effect in January 2026, cover more than 1,400 tariff classifications, with rates ranging from 5% to 50%. An additional measure introduced in April expanded coverage to 185 more tariff classifications.

Affected sectors include automobiles and auto parts, steel, aluminum, textiles, footwear, plastics, household appliances, furniture and electronics.

The measures apply according to the product’s country of origin and tariff classification, rather than simply the country from which a shipment is dispatched. Products originating in China can therefore remain subject to the applicable duties even when purchased through an intermediary in another country.

However, goods originating in countries with which Mexico has trade agreements may qualify for preferential treatment if they satisfy the relevant rules of origin and documentation requirements.

China does not have a free-trade agreement with Mexico, making Chinese-origin goods particularly exposed to the higher duties.

The tariff policy adds another layer of pressure on Chinese manufacturers seeking to expand their presence in Mexico, particularly in sectors such as automobiles, electric vehicles, batteries, steel and electronics.

USMCA Negotiations Put Chinese Manufacturing Under Scrutiny

The dispute over product origin is emerging as a central issue in the review of USMCA, which underpins trade between the United States, Mexico and Canada.

Washington wants to encourage more production within North America and reduce reliance on components sourced from outside the region, particularly from China and other Asian manufacturing centers.

Greer said in July that changes to automotive rules of origin would take time to negotiate, alongside stronger labor and environmental requirements.

The negotiations could affect manufacturers that rely on Chinese suppliers for batteries, electronics, vehicle components and other industrial inputs while assembling finished products in Mexico.

For Chinese automakers and suppliers, stricter rules could make it more difficult to use Mexican manufacturing operations as a route into the U.S. market if their products fail to meet the regional content requirements for preferential treatment.

However, the existing USMCA rules of origin remain in force unless the three countries agree to legally effective changes. The proposals under discussion should therefore not be confused with requirements that have already been adopted.

The United States, Mexico and Canada began the agreement’s joint review process in 2026, with Washington seeking changes that would strengthen North American manufacturing and address what it considers unfair trade practices by countries outside the agreement.

Mexico Seeks Asian Investment and More Exports

Alongside calling for stronger enforcement against tariff evasion, Ebrard urged Mexico’s Pacific trade partners to purchase more Mexican products to help address the country’s large trade imbalance.

He also proposed joint investments in manufacturing, particularly electronics, as Mexico seeks to strengthen its industrial capacity and expand its participation in regional supply chains.

The appeal presents Mexico with a balancing act. The country wants to preserve access to the U.S. market, attract foreign investment and strengthen domestic manufacturing while maintaining commercial relationships with Asian economies that supply many of its industrial inputs.

China remains an important part of that equation because of its manufacturing capacity and role in supplying components, machinery, electronics and other intermediate goods used by manufacturers worldwide.

For Mexico, tighter origin controls could help address Washington’s concerns and protect the benefits of its trade agreements. But they could also increase compliance costs for manufacturers that depend on internationally sourced components.

The outcome of the USMCA negotiations will help determine how much access Chinese suppliers and manufacturers retain to North American production networks and the conditions under which their products can qualify for preferential trade treatment.

Nov 26 : Charles Leclerc spoke of his love of Ferrari on Thursday and said he had been hurt by those questioning his loyalty after costly collisions with Formula One teammate Lewis Hamilton.
The Monegasque also ended speculation about there being a clause in his new contract stipulating he had number one status, saying that was not the case and never something he wanted or was interested in.
Leclerc said he was not allowed to discuss possible solutions to the track situation or any rules of engagement - "I cannot disclose that" -  but nobody should doubt him as a team player.
"The only thing that I don't like seeing is people questioning my integrity to the team, my love for the team. I've been in Ferrari since 2019. I think there's nothing clearer than the love I have for the team, and I will do absolutely everything in order to bring Ferrari back to the top," he said at the Qatar Grand Prix.

"Of course, mistakes happen along the way and always will. We just try to minimise them, and particularly between teammates. But yeah, I think it's more the question mark that I have seen going around that hurts me more than anything else."
'TWO VERY STRONG DRIVERS'
Leclerc said a solution needed to be found to prevent further clashes.
"At the end of the day, we are two very strong drivers that want to finish one ahead of the other," he added.
"Unfortunately, it finished recently, whether it's in (Las Vegas) or Monza or Mexico, there's been a bit too many events of those lately, and we need to find a solution as a team to make sure that these kinds of things don't happen again.
"As a team, we cannot afford to clash between teammates, and I think that is very clear for everyone. For the clash in particular of Las Vegas, as I said, I took responsibility. I think there's just tension around that we just need to dissipate and make sure that we look at more positive days in the future. That's all I'm looking for."
Leclerc emphasised that his relationship with seven-time champion Hamilton, the sport's most successful driver, was strong off track.
Hamilton was also not giving anything away about how Ferrari would proceed with the final two races of the season after the latest clash of teammates in Las Vegas that principal Fred Vasseur described last weekend as "unacceptable".
"We had internal discussions," said Hamilton. "Everything stays internal.
"It's been positive. Charles and I sat here earlier and had a good discussion." 
Ferrari are second to champions Mercedes in the constructors' standings with two races remaining and should secure that place in Qatar. The Italian team have not won a title since 2008.

items.title: Tech leaders urge to build more data centres in Canada
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canadian tech leaders gathered by policy group Build Canada have signed an open letter urging the country to build more data centres.
items.body: Canadian tech leaders have signed an open letter urging Canada to build more data centres or risk having to rent computing capacity elsewhere. The 35 signatories gathered by policy group Build Canada warn that relying on other countries for data centres will hamper the country’s access and put it at risk of supply disruptions. “The demand for increased compute capacity is here and data centres will be built whether Canada hosts them or not,” the open letter says.  “The only choice in front of us is whether we build it, shape it and earn from it, or rent it from the countries that do. The world will not wait on our decision.” The letter signed by Shopify Inc. president Harley Finkelstein, Neo Financial co-founder Jeff Adamson and Koho chief executive Daniel Eberhard positions data centres as crucial to the adoption of artificial intelligence. It also frames the hulking facilities, which house technology infrastructure, as necessary for internet usage, cancer screening, wildfire prediction and software used to run businesses and governments. In pushing for more data centres, the signatories point to documents received by the federal AI minister in January that suggest Canada had about 337 megawatts of AI data centre capacity.  The signatories point out the government’s own AI strategy estimates Canada will need 5.5 gigawatts of domestic capacity by 2030. “That is 16 times what we have right now,” the letter points out. “We must build data centres, and we must build them faster. Not building them is not an option.” The letter comes as several data centre projects, including some with links to tech giants like Meta and Anthropic, are slated in Canada but face fierce opposition from local communities and environmentalists. Opponents say data centres are noisy and hog water, land and electricity while contributing few jobs relative to their massive footprint. Build Canada’s letter argues data centres use less water than a golf course, are about as loud as refrigerator and only drive up power bills when data centres are connected to small, tight grids, so the facilities should bring their own power.  --- Tara Deschamps, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 26, 2026.

items.body:
News
/ GuruFocus
/ Meta Platforms Stocks Jump 3.4% on Reported Amazon Talks Over Muse AI Agent

Meta Platforms Stocks Jump 3.4% on Reported Amazon Talks Over Muse AI Agent 1 min read

META AMZN
Meta Platforms META shares jumped 3.4% to $609.89 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 25, after Fortune reported that Amazon is in talks that could let Meta's Muse AI agent back onto its marketplace. The reversal was sharp. Shares had dropped 3.74% to $567.75 earlier in the session, so the close marked a 7.4% swing off the low.
Muse is a personal AI agent that books reservations and buys products for its users. Meta launched it in the U.S. in September, and more than 10 million people in the U.S. and Canada had set it up by October, according to TradingKey coverage of the talks. Amazon blocked the agent in September, citing its user agreements. Any deal would need sign-off from both chief executives, and both companies declined to comment. Andy Jassy has said Amazon is open to outside shopping agents if they deliver fair value in return.

A deal would give Muse access to the largest U.S. online store, the difference between an agent that recommends and one that completes purchases. That is the monetization path investors want after heavy AI spending, though terms could include fees or data-sharing that dilute the payoff. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 99/100, with elite profitability, a sturdy balance sheet and solid momentum. GF Value of $892.33 implies a 31.7% discount and a "significantly undervalued" label, suggesting the market still weighs Meta's capex more heavily than its earning power. The next test is a signed agreement; until then, Wednesday's rally rests on a report, not a contract.

[グダニスク　２６日　ロイター] - 欧州外為市場では、米国の感謝祭で薄商いとなる中ドル高が一服し、今年の高値をやや下回る水準で推移した。世界の株式市場が反発し、安全資産への逃避の動きが和らいだ。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は一進一退の動きを見せた後、終盤では横ばいの１０３．７０と、２０２５年３月以来の高値をわずかに下回る水準となった。

シンガポールの銀行大手オーバーシー・チャイニーズ銀行の為替ストラテジスト、シム・モー・シオン氏は、ドルと株式の関係は不安定な状態が続く可能性があると指摘。安全資産としての需要と、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブーム減速の深刻化が米国成長を圧迫するとの懸念の間で板挟みになっているとの見方を示した。

さらに、「ドルのさらなる上昇を狙うリスクリワードの妙味は薄れてきているが、タカ派的な米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のリスクがドルを下支えし続けるだろう」と述べた。

円は対ドルでほぼ横ばいの１５９．２０付近で推移した。

ユーロも横ばいの１．０９８ドルで推移。今週初めに２０２５年４月以来の安値まで下落した後、３日続伸に向かう勢い。

ただ、短期的に重要な節目である１．１２ドルを回復するのは難しいとサンタンデールＡＭのシニアストラテジスト、トマス・ガルシアプリニョス氏は指摘。新たなレンジが１．０７ドルから１．１２ドルの間で形成されつつあると述べた。

ポンドは小幅低下の１．３１１ドル。直近１６営業日のうち１３営業日で下落し、月間ベースでは対ドルで２％超下落している。

スイスフランは対ドルで０．４％安の１ドル＝０．８３４１フラン。前日は安全資産への需要から０．５％上昇していた。

items.title: Nvidia halts shipments of AI servers to four Southeast Asian countries
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Nvidia has asked manufacturing partners to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia following new US export controls on advanced AI chips.
items.body: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to stop shipping servers containing its chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, the Financial Times reported on Thursday. The move follows new US curbs that took effect last week, which require export licences for shipments of advanced chips to several Southeast Asian countries. The measures are part of efforts by Washington to shut down routes that Chinese firms are believed to use to obtain advanced AI chips. According to the FT, manufacturing partners such as Dell and Supermicro, which package Nvidia's chips into servers, told buyers in the four countries that Nvidia would not allow their orders to be shipped. It was unclear whether the halt would be temporary as Nvidia and its partners work through compliance requirements under new US export controls, the newspaper said, citing three people familiar with the matter. Nvidia, Dell and Supermicro did not immediately respond to requests for comment outside regular business hours. The Commerce Department published the new rule days after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy who previously worked at Singapore-based cloud company Megaspeed. Nvidia's board subsequently reinstated Huang as CEO on November 23. Megaspeed, an Nvidia partner that rents computing power at its data centres, has come under scrutiny for possible illegal diversion of advanced AI chips to China.

Nov 26 : Germany and Eintracht Frankfurt forward Laura Freigang has been suspended for 16 months after committing three anti-doping whereabouts failures, the German Football Association (DFB) said on Thursday, ruling her out of next year's women's World Cup.
The 28-year-old accepted a case resolution agreement reached between the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA), NADA, the DFB and herself.
"All of the Athlete's individual competitive results since 23rd February 2026 are disqualified with all resulting consequences, including the forfeiture of medals, honours, points and prizes," the DFB said.
"The results achieved by the Athlete's respective team in the relevant matches remain unaffected."

"It's important to me to emphasise once again that I was never suspected of doping at any point," she wrote on Instagram.
"I am aware of my responsibility regarding my reporting obligations and the importance of clean sports. At the same time, my case wasn't always as black and white as it might have appeared from the outside. My agreement to a settlement does not mean that I share all the assessments of my case."
Freigang, Frankfurt's captain, has scored 17 goals in 45 appearances for Germany who won the women's World Cup in 2003 and 2007.
The World Cup in Brazil starts on June 24.

Nov 26 : George Russell described his latest spat with Max Verstappen as "quite amusing" and said he wanted to fight the Red Bull driver on the track rather than engage in any war of words off it.
Mercedes driver Russell and four-time Formula One champion Verstappen have an animosity dating back years that flared in Las Vegas last week when Russell accused the Dutch driver of trying to "screw" him on track and was then dealt a stinging post-race putdown by the jubilant winner.
Speaking to reporters on Thursday ahead of the season's penultimate Qatar Grand Prix at the Lusail circuit, his first appearance since Las Vegas, Russell said it had all been avoidable, unnecessary and not something he wanted to continue.
"I don't really have much to say," he said when asked what was really going on between the two. "You know, it was quite amusing I found some of the comments post-race.

"But at the end of the day he drove an incredible race and won it. So he can afford to say what he wants really. And from my side, yeah, moving on."
HAD A BIT OF A LAUGH
Russell and Verstappen had fought for the lead in Las Vegas but the Briton's hopes of snatching a late win vanished when he hit the barriers while trying to pass teammate Kimi Antonelli with two laps to go.
Verstappen did not attempt to hide his delight, suggesting it was karma for Russell and that his rival for the championship runner-up slot behind Mercedes' newly-crowned champion Antonelli was just not on the same level.
Russell said he stood by what he had said but had to accept that Verstappen was the winner on the day.
"I'm sure he had a bit of a laugh about that and that was reasonably amusing," he added. "So from my side, just a new race weekend and try and focus on the driving and move on."
The Briton said it was not a "war of words off track" but he may have been "too open and honest with the media" and the "biggest takeaway" from last weekend was to remember he was speaking to millions of people through just one television camera.
"The competition is on track and I think that's where I want to have the battles, want to have the fights," he said. "I respect Max immensely for his driving talents and everything he's achieved on track and that's that really.
"You don't need to agree with one another," he added later. "I'm not looking to be best mates with anybody on the grid. I'm just working and looking and fighting to win."
Russell said both championships being won meant his appetite for risk was probably set too high, with the driver having little to lose other than a podium that would ultimately be of little importance.
"If that was race one of the season, there's no way I would have gone for that move with two laps remaining," explained Russell. "But two races to go, I kind of wanted to go for it."

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump on Thursday (Nov 26) posted that he would like to see Russian leader Vladimir Putin "pull back all Military aggression against territories throughout Europe" in the hope this could lead to a quick settlement of the war in Ukraine.
"During my conversations in China with President Vladimir Putin, of Russia, I spent a lot of time talking about the fact that I would like to see President Putin pull back all Military aggression against territories throughout Europe, in the hopes that a Deal can be made between Russia and Ukraine, and made quickly," Trump wrote in a Truth Social post.
"I really believe this is a strong possibility - Thousands of people are being killed each and every month, A COMPLETE BLOODBATH," Trump said.
Trump has frequently urged a negotiated end to the war in Ukraine, but on Thursday he used broader language about "territories throughout Europe" without specifying what that meant.
Since the Russian invasion of Ukraine started in 2022, other countries occasionally have accused Russia of provocative behaviour.
Poland, a NATO member, this week accused Russia of deliberately violating Polish airspace. Estonia recently linked an arson attack to Russia's military intelligence service.

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump on Thursday (Nov 26) demanded an immediate probe into what he alleged was a deliberate decision to release "fake" growth numbers before this month's midterm elections .
The US Commerce Department's Bureau of Economic Analysis on Wednesday revised third-quarter annualised growth up to 4.3 per cent from the advance estimate of 3.4 per cent it announced on Oct 29. Trump 's Republican Party suffered heavy losses in the Nov 3 election.
"It was just revealed that the REAL Numbers on the Economy, published before the Election, were FAKE," Trump said in a Truth Social post, without providing evidence.
"Why wasn't the correct number issued before the Election? I am asking for an immediate investigation of this situation. This is not a small error, this is a massive, and purposeful, error," he said.
The BEA has previously said that its estimates can differ from the final numbers because advance estimates for quarterly growth lack complete source data on inventories, trade, and consumer spending on services.
Last year, Trump fired a top Labour Department official, accusing her without evidence of manipulating the figures and adding to already growing concerns about the quality of economic data published by the federal government.

items.title: Xpeng Vice Chairman Reveals: IRON Robot Price Comparable to Electric Cars, Earliest Launch in Q2 Next Year
items.author: 华尔街见闻
items.creator: 华尔街见闻
items.summary: Gu Hongdi, Vice Chairman of XPeng, revealed that the price of the IRON humanoid robot will be set with reference to electric vehicle prices and may be close to the median price of electric vehicles. XPeng's current models are priced between 119,800 and 309,800 yuan. IRON is expected to go on sale as early as the second quarter of 2027, with the goal of selling tens of thousands of units that year. Xingxing Wang, founder of Unitree Robotics, predicts that in the next 5 to 10 years, the annual production of robots in China is expected to exceed 20 million units, surpassing that of automobiles.
items.body: The commercialization of humanoid robots is accelerating, and industry competition is now extending from technological R&D to product pricing, mass production capability, and practical application scenarios. On November 26, according to Bloomberg, Xpeng Vice Chairman Gu Hongdi revealed in an interview on Thursday that Xpeng IRON humanoid robot will be priced similarly to electric vehicles, possibly close to the median price of electric vehicles. The current price range for Xpeng's available models is approximately 119,800 to 309,800 yuan. IRON is planned to begin training as a retail assistant in the first quarter of 2027 and the earliest public sale may start in the second quarter. Gu Hongdi stated that Xpeng's goal is to sell tens of thousands of humanoid robots in 2027, viewing this year as a key phase for scaling up and commercialization. In addition to hardware sales, the company is optimistic about recurring revenue opportunities from software upgrades, training services, and data infrastructure for robots. This commercialization plan also reflects Xpeng’s desire to expand its robot business from a single hardware product to an integrated hardware and software model. In addition to IRON, Xpeng is pushing forward with other AI-related businesses such as autonomous driving and flying vehicles. The company announced this week that its first model designed specifically for Robotaxi is scheduled for release in 2027, following autonomous driving system trials in Guangzhou. From Hardware Sales to Recurring Revenue: Xpeng Expands Robot Business Model As Xpeng intensifies its focus on the robotics business, its core automotive operations are still in a phase of transformation and improved profitability. According to the third quarter earnings released by Xpeng this week, company revenue grew by 19% year-on-year, but profitability has yet to be achieved. While the automotive division continues with technological investments and adjustments to its product structure, new businesses such as robotics are expected to drive long-term growth prospects. Gu Hongdi mentioned that the company is addressing industry cost pressures through technology development, product adjustments, and model structure changes in order to improve profitability in its automotive business, while also promoting the commercial sustainability of its new ventures. For Xpeng, the robotics business is not only a new product line but also carries expectations for expanded growth opportunities. In terms of revenue models, hardware sales are just the first step. Software upgrades, training services, and data infrastructure are expected to become subsequent sources of income. However, whether this model is viable still depends on whether robots can be deployed in enough practical use cases and generate sustained customer demand. Will China’s Annual Robot Production Exceed 20 Million Units? While Xpeng is accelerating commercialization, expectations for the size of the robot market across the industry are also rising. On the same day, Unitree Robotics founder and chairman Wang Xingxing stated at the WISE2026 conference held in Beijing that, in the next 5 to 10 years, China’s annual robot production could exceed 20 million units, surpassing automobile production. This prediction equates the future scale of the robotics industry with that of the automotive sector. For automakers like Xpeng, experience gained in supply chain management, manufacturing, and cost control in the automotive space could become an advantage for their robotics operations. However, whether large-scale mass production of robots can be achieved still depends on manufacturing costs, technological maturity, and actual demand for applications. From Xpeng’s plan to sell tens of thousands of robots in 2027, to Wang Xingxing’s prediction that annual industry production could exceed 20 million units, the industry’s prospects are full of imagination, but true scale still requires market validation. Whether IRON can launch as planned and open up the consumer market will be a crucial test for the commercialization of Xpeng robots.

FAST

STOCKHOLM, Nov 26 : A meeting of European Union countries on December 15 on whether to approve Tesla's assisted-driving system across the bloc may include a formal vote by member states on approval, according to a draft agenda published by the European Commission.
Reuters reported on Wednesday that a meeting where the technology would be discussed had been postponed to December 15.
On Thursday, in a draft agenda published for the meeting, the Commission explicitly raises the possibility of a vote for the first time, saying EU countries will further examine the Dutch request to grant type approval for the system "with possible vote". 
The vote is a key step in Tesla's effort to roll out the technology across Europe, with nearly a dozen countries having followed the Dutch lead.
But EU-wide approval requires backing from at least 15 of the bloc's 27 member states representing 65 per cent of its population.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米中間選挙前のＧＤＰ成長率は「偽物」、トランプ氏　即時調査を要求
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、今月の中間選挙前に「偽の」国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率を公表するという意図的な決定があったと主張し、この件について即時に調査を行うよう求めた。 

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「選挙前に公表された経済の『本当の数字』が『偽物』だったことが明らかになった」と、根拠を示すことなく主張。

さらに「なぜ正しい数字が選挙前に公表されなかったのか。この件について即時の調査を求める。これは小さな誤りではなく、重大かつ意図的な誤りだ」と述べた。

米商務省経済分析局（ＢＥＡ）は２５日、第３・四半期のＧＤＰ改定値は年率換算で前期比４．３％増と、１０月２９日に公表した速報値の３．４％増から上方修正した。トランプ氏の率いる共和党は１１月３日の選挙で大きな敗北を喫した。 

ＢＥＡはこれまで、四半期成長率の速報値は在庫、貿易、サービスへの消費者支出に関する完全なデータを欠いているため、速報値が最終値と異なる場合があると説明している。

items.title: Turkey’s Çöpler gold mine restarts after 2024 fatal landslide
items.author: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.creator: Staff Writer
items.summary: Anagold targets 1.3 tonnes of gold by year-end as Ankara pushes to boost domestic production.
items.body:
Turkey’s Çöpler gold mine restarts after 2024 fatal landslide
Anagold targets 1.3 tonnes of gold by year-end as Ankara pushes to boost domestic production.

Staff Writer
|
November 26, 2026 - 10:40 am

Categories:
Europe
Gold
Suppliers & Equipment

Çöpler sulphide project. ( Image courtesy of Anagold Madencilik. )

The Çöpler mine in eastern Turkey has resumed gold production more than two years after a fatal heap leach failure , restoring a key source of domestic supply in one of the world’s largest bullion markets.

Operator Anagold Madencilik began processing stockpiled ore at its pressure oxidation plant in the third quarter under a temporary operating licence, according to Bloomberg . The restart hadn’t previously been announced.

Anagold aims to produce about 1.3 tonnes of gold by year-end. Before the suspension, the mine’s annual production stood at about 6.9 tonnes, equivalent to a fifth of Turkey’s total output in 2023.

The restart supports Turkey’s ambitions to expand domestic gold production and reduce its dependence on imports. Bullion accounts for more than 60% of the country’s central bank reserves, while the government is targeting annual production of 100 tonnes, Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said in parliament this week, without specifying a timeline.

The resumption follows the exit of US-based SSR Mining (TSX: SSRM)(ASX: SSR), which sold its 80% stake in the operation to Turkish conglomerate Cengiz Holding for $1.5 billion. Turkey’s Lidya Madencilik Sanayi ve Ticaret AS is a co-owner.

Environmental fallout

The Feb. 13, 2024, heap leach failure dislodged about 10 million cubic metres of material across a 200-metre slope, trapping and killing nine workers.

Turkish authorities revoked SSR’s environmental permits days after the disaster and later demanded the company cover cleanup costs.

SSR review of Çöpler mine incident points to third-party design flaw

The landslide also raised concerns about potential cyanide contamination of the Euphrates River, which flows through Turkey, Syria and Iraq. Turkey’s environment ministry said water samples showed no signs of pollution, state-run Anadolu Agency reported at the time.

The disaster marked the second major operational disruption at Çöpler in less than two years. In June 2022, Turkey’s environment ministry ordered the mine to suspend operations following a cyanide waste spill.

Legal proceedings over the fatal landslide remain ongoing. The latest hearing in the trial of 43 people accused of causing multiple deaths and injuries through negligence took place last month, Turkish newspaper Cumhuriyet reported .

items.title: トランプ氏、プーチン氏に自制求める　欧州全域での軍事攻撃巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、先週行ったロシアのプーチン大統領との会談で、ウクライナ戦争の早期解決につながることを期待し、ロシアが欧州全域の領土に対する軍事攻撃を控えることを望んでいると伝えたと明らかにした。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「中国でプーチン大統領と会談した際、欧州全域の領土に対するあらゆる軍事的攻撃から手を引いてもらいたいと私が望んでいることについて、多くの時間を割いて話し合った。ロシアとウクライナの間で合意が迅速に成立することを期待してのことだ」と述べた。

その上で、「これは非常に可能性の高いことだと本当に信じている。毎月何千人もの人々が殺されており、まさに大惨事だ」と述べた。

トランプ大統領の「欧州全域の領土」という表現は、ウクライナを超える地域を示唆している。また、プーチン大統領に対し、どのような攻撃を控えるよう求めているのかについては踏み込まなかった。

北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国のポーランド政府は最近、ロシアの偵察用ドローン（無人機）が一時的に国境を越えたとして、ロシアによる意図的な領空侵犯だと非難。エストニアも最近、防衛企業に対する破壊工作について、ロシアが関与していると非難している。

items.title: モジタバ師「全てのイラン人をバシジ隊員に」、民兵組織に浸透拡大促す
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ドバイ ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ドバイ ２６日 ロイター] - イランの最高指導者モジタバ・ハメネイ師は２６日、イスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）傘下の民兵組織「バシジ」に対し、社会への浸透を拡大し、「全てのイラン人をバシジ隊員に」することを目指すよう呼びかけた。

米国とイスラエルが今年２月下旬に開始した戦争勃発以降、イラン当局は、国内各地で繰り返される政府支持の集会を組織化するためにバシジを頼りにしてきた。国営メディアはこうした集会を、イスラム共和国に対する広範な大衆の支持の表れとして報じている。 

国営メディアの報道によると、今回のメッセージは「バシジ週間」に合わせて発表されたもので、同組織に対し、正式なメンバーではないがイデオロギーを共有する人々を含め、より幅広い支持層を活用して国の問題解決に役立てるよう促した。

モジタバ師は、戦争の初期攻撃で殺害された父アリ・ハメネイ師の後を継いで以降、公の場に姿を見せていない。同師は文書による声明を通じて発信を続けており、イラン当局者は同師が公の場に姿を見せない理由として、安全上の懸念を挙げている。

items.title: ＥＣＢ次期総裁にデコス氏、ＥＵ首脳が合意　スペイン出身初
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブリュセル／フランクフルト　２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブリュセル／フランクフルト　２６日 ロイター] - ユーロ圏各国は２６日、スペイン出身のパブロ・エルナンデス・デコス氏（５５）を欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の次期総裁候補に選出した。来年２月に早期退任するラガルド総裁の後任となる。中央銀行業務で豊富な経験を持つ同氏の起用はＥＣＢの政策の継続性を示唆している。

今回の選出は広く予想されていた。６人で構成するＥＣＢ専務理事会のポストを巡り、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の主要国が数カ月にわたり非公開で進めてきた交渉が決着した。ドイツは強い影響力を持つチーフエコノミストのポストを、フランスは市場操作を監督するポストを得ることになる。 

金融経済学者のデコス氏はスペインの銀行セクター救済や新型コロナウイルス禍への対応、パンデミック後のインフレ対策など、数々の危機を経験してきたベテラン。スペイン中銀の前総裁で、現在は国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）の総支配人を務めている。

スペイン出身のＥＣＢ総裁は初めて。南欧出身の総裁としてはイタリアのマリオ・ドラギ氏以来となる。

コスタ大統領はＸへの投稿で「１２月に予定されているＥＣＢ新指導部の正式任命の下地となる」と述べた。

南欧の金融政策当局者は金融緩和に前向きな「ハト派」とみられることが多いが、デコス氏は穏健派かつ実用主義者として評価を得ている。

次期ＥＣＢ総裁ポストにはオランダ中銀のクノット前総裁も候補に挙がっていたが、オランダは２６日、デコス氏支持を決定し、事実上、自国候補を取り下げた。 

コスタＥＵ大統領によると、ＥＵの首脳は、フランス出身のローレンス・ブーン氏を専務理事、ドイツ出身のマルクス・ブルネルマイヤー氏をチーフエコノミストに充てる人事でも合意した。

items.body:
ＥＣＢ次期総裁にデコス氏、ＥＵ首脳が合意　スペイン出身初
11/26 23:09 配信

2024年2月6日撮影。REUTERS/Yiannis Kourtoglou（ロイター） [ブリュセル／フランクフルト　２６日 ロイター] - ユーロ圏各国は２６日、スペイン出身のパブロ・エルナンデス・デコス氏（５５）を欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の次期総裁候補に選出した。来年２月に早期退任するラガルド総裁の後任となる。中央銀行業務で豊富な経験を持つ同氏の起用はＥＣＢの政策の継続性を示唆している。

今回の選出は広く予想されていた。６人で構成するＥＣＢ専務理事会のポストを巡り、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の主要国が数カ月にわたり非公開で進めてきた交渉が決着した。ドイツは強い影響力を持つチーフエコノミストのポストを、フランスは市場操作を監督するポストを得ることになる。 

金融経済学者のデコス氏はスペインの銀行セクター救済や新型コロナウイルス禍への対応、パンデミック後のインフレ対策など、数々の危機を経験してきたベテラン。スペイン中銀の前総裁で、現在は国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）の総支配人を務めている。

スペイン出身のＥＣＢ総裁は初めて。南欧出身の総裁としてはイタリアのマリオ・ドラギ氏以来となる。

コスタ大統領はＸへの投稿で「１２月に予定されているＥＣＢ新指導部の正式任命の下地となる」と述べた。

南欧の金融政策当局者は金融緩和に前向きな「ハト派」とみられることが多いが、デコス氏は穏健派かつ実用主義者として評価を得ている。

次期ＥＣＢ総裁ポストにはオランダ中銀のクノット前総裁も候補に挙がっていたが、オランダは２６日、デコス氏支持を決定し、事実上、自国候補を取り下げた。

各候補はなお承認手続きを経る必要があるが、おおむね形式的なものとなる。１２月のＥＵ首脳会議で最終承認を得られるよう、手続きが完了する見通しだ。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［フランクフルト　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［フランクフルト　２６日　ロイター］ - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２６日に公表した１０月２８─２９日の理事会の議事要旨で、理事会メンバーが利上げに傾いていたものの、インフレリスクを見極める材料をさらに集めるため、先送りを選んだことが分かった。

同理事会は金利を据え置いた。ただインフレ率は従来の想定より高くなる可能性が高く、一段の引き締めが必要になるかもしれないと警告した。

議事要旨は「多くのメンバーは、９月の理事会以降に入手したデータが一段の金融引き締めの根拠を裏付けたことから、今回の会合で利上げを支持することもできたと指摘した」と記している。

メンバーは、インフレの二次的波及効果はまだ表れていないものの、それを未然に防ぐ必要があるとの認識で一致した。

１０月の利上げの可能性について、議事要旨は「今回の会合で利上げしても、必要な金融引き締めを前倒しするだけになる」としている。

同理事会以降、理事会メンバーの多くが公の場や非公式の発言で、１２月１７日の理事会で０．２５％の利上げを示唆している。

items.title: Global stocks rise and tech shares rebound as U.S. closes for Thanksgiving
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: U.S. stock futures also climbed, with the S&P 500 futures up 0.5 per cent. U.S. markets will reopen Friday for a holiday-shortened session.
items.body: HONG KONG — Shares advanced in Europe and Asia on Thursday while U.S. markets were closed for the Thanksgiving holiday. Buying of stocks tied to artificial intelligence helped push benchmarks in Asia higher, though some profit-taking by investors toward the end of the day pared those gains. Investors have been growing cautious about the AI trade. They also are watching for impacts from the latest tariff hikes Washington plans to impose on China, Japan, the European Union and other trading partners. In early European trading, Germany’s DAX jumped 1.9 per cent to 25,180.12, while France’s CAC 40 climbed 1.8 per cent to 8,126.47. Britain’s FTSE 100 added 1.6 per cent to 10,591.83. U.S. stock futures also climbed, with the S&P 500 futures up 0.5 per cent. U.S. markets will reopen Friday for a holiday-shortened session. In Asia, Japan’s Nikkei 225 rebounded and closed 0.9 per cent higher at 57,499.16. OpenAI investor SoftBank Group jumped 7.3 per cent, while memory chipmaker Kioxia Holdings surged 12.6 per cent. Shares of chip equipment maker Tokyo Electron were up 0.6 per cent. South Korea’s benchmark Kospi index added 0.3 per cent to 4,711.21 after a 6.2 per cent drop a day earlier. Samsung Electronics gained 0.4 per cent, while memory chipmaker SK Hynix rose 2.2 per cent. Taiwan’s Taiex was 2.5 per cent higher. But shares of its leading chipmaker TSMC, or Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., edged 0.2 per cent lower. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng index was 1.2 per cent higher at 22,226.88. The Shanghai Composite index was up less than 0.1 per cent at 3,476.88. Australia’s S&P/ASX 200 gained 0.8 per cent to 8,763.80. India’s Sensex rose 0.5 per cent. Wall Street closed mixed ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday. The benchmark S&P 500 index lost 0.3 per cent Wednesday after falling as much as 3.2 per cent earlier in the day. The technology-heavy Nasdaq composite closed 0.6 per cent lower, after recovering from a drop of as much as 4.6 per cent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average picked up 0.3 per cent. Nvidia fell 3.9 per cent as AI shares lost steam for a second day after Jensen Huang’s comeback as CEO. On Wednesday, S&P Global Ratings warned it could downgrade Nvidia’s credit rating over concerns surrounding its management and governance. Broadcom, which had fallen sharply earlier in the day, was 0.1 per cent lower at the close. Anthropic, which began public trading last week, recovered from an early drop and ended 1.1 per cent higher, though still below its IPO, or initial public offering, price of US$83 per share. In commodities trading, oil prices climbed early Thursday as tensions in the Middle East persisted even as global oil supply continued to recover. Brent crude, the international standard, was 0.5 per cent higher at $91.09 per barrel. It was trading at approximately $72 a barrel before the war began in late February. Benchmark U.S. crude gained one per cent to $84.51 per barrel. Recent reports of vessels being targeted in the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial waterway for global oil transport, have contributed to concerns over oil flows and “brought supply risks back into focus,” ING commodities strategists Ewa Manthey and Warren Patterson said in a commentary Thursday. The U.S. dollar rose to 159.30 Japanese yen from 159.16 yen. The euro was trading at $1.0968, down from $1.0974. Chan Ho-him, The Associated Press

items.title: 米アルトリア、英インペリアル買収検討表明　ＪＴも関心と報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２６日　ロイター］ - 米たばこ大手アルトリア・グループは２６日、英たばこ大手インペリアル・ブランズを全額現金で買収することを検討していると明らかにした。同社事業の一部を巡っては別の第三者とも協議しているものの、まだ合意には至っていないという。インペリアル・ブランズを巡っては、日本たばこ産業（ＪＴ）も買収を検討していると伝えられている。

ロンドン上場のインペリアル・ブランズの株価は、一時１７．６％高の３５．６２ポンドに急騰した。これにより時価総額は約２６７億７０００万ポンド（３５０億７０００万ドル）となった。同社は先週、コスト管理を強化するため、従業員の最大約５分の１に相当する最大４６００人を削減する計画を発表していた。

items.title: 豪ＬＮＧ輸出規制法案、最終採決来年2月に延期　国内供給確保
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Christine Chen　Helen Clark

［シドニー／パース　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Christine Chen　Helen Clark

［シドニー／パース　２６日　ロイター］ - オーストラリア上院は２６日、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）生産者に生産量の最大５分の１を国内向けに確保するよう義務付ける規則について、最終採決を２０２７年２月に延期した。

上院は国内ガス留保法案の第２読会を開き、賛成２１、反対１０で可決した。しかし、同法案を担当するエアーズ産業相は、主に手続き上の第３読会を提案した上で、上院が再開する２７年２月まで延期するよう求めた。

政府は５年ごとの独立した見直しなどの修正を土壇場で加えた。このため法案は、成立前に最終採決のため下院へ差し戻される必要が生じていた。

法案は市場へのガス供給を増やすことが目的で、条文自体はすでに合意されているが、成立は２７年になる。

制度は２８年１月に施行する予定。確保する正確な量はエネルギー規制当局が決める。予測需要の１１０％に当たる余剰を生み出す設計で、政府はこれを「適度な供給過剰」と説明している。同国産ガスの二大購入国である中国と日本は、同制度に懸念を示している。

野党側は、現行の留保政策では国内のガス開発が十分に促されないことを懸念。

中道左派のアルバニージー政権は、国内最大のＬＮＧ輸出州である西オーストラリア州を適用除外とすることで暫定合意し、野党の支持を得た。ただ、この除外は正式で恒久的なものではなく、閣僚の監督の下に置かれる。

ガス生産会社は、供給者に「販売しなければならない」義務を課す条項があるとして反対している。企業側は価格が下がり過ぎて、新規供給への投資が妨げられると主張する。

FAST

Nov 26 : US tobacco group Altria said on Thursday it was considering a possible all-cash bid for Imperial Brands and was discussing a deal involving part of the British tobacco group's business with another party, while Japan Tobacco was also reported to be weighing a bid.
The moves potentially set the stage for one of the largest deals in tobacco industry history, combining three companies that together account for a significant share of the global cigarette market.
Shares in London-listed Imperial jumped 13.8 per cent to 3,449 pence, giving it a market value of £25.90 billion ($33.93 billion).
Depending on the structure of the deal, Altria could overtake British American Tobacco as the world's second-most valuable listed tobacco company, behind US Philip Morris International.

Bloomberg News reported earlier on Thursday that Japan Tobacco was evaluating a potential acquisition of Imperial Brands, possibly with a partner, splitting up its assets around the world, citing people familiar with the matter.
Analysts said a joint US-Japanese takeover could swerve antitrust objections and solve strategic challenges.
The potential deal reflects mounting pressure on cigarette makers to find new growth avenues as smoking rates fall, and some struggle to compensate with newer nicotine products.
Imperial said it had not had any discussions with, or received any approach from, Altria or a third party. "The Board is clear in its duty of aiming to maximise shareholder value and will consider any proposal, should one be made," it said in a statement.
Japan Tobacco declined to comment on Bloomberg's report.
IMPERIAL'S APPEAL TO BUYERS
Imperial would give any buyer a portfolio of established cigarette brands spanning Europe and the United States, including Davidoff, Gauloises and Kool, sold in more than 100 markets.
A deal could mark a return to international cigarette sales for Altria, two decades after it spun off its international division to focus on the United States. That move created Philip Morris International.
Altria has not sold cigarettes or most other products outside the US since, leaving it more exposed than rivals to several key challenges in that market.
Altria has a market value of $126.89 billion, while Japan Tobacco, which sells brands including Camel and Benson & Hedges in more than 130 markets, is valued at roughly $69.45 billion.
A deal for Imperial Brands would rank among the largest recent acquisitions of a British company by an overseas buyer. London-listed firms have become attractive acquisition targets in recent years due to depressed valuations compared to their rivals listed on other European or US exchanges.
Imperial Brands trades at just 8.3 times forward earnings compared with 12.6 times for Altria and 17.7 times for Japan Tobacco, LSEG data showed.
The mega-deal would add to this year's global M&A haul, which has been expected by bankers to rival the record-breaking 2021 total even after a pullback in dealmaking in the wake of rising rates.
SEARCHING FOR GROWTH
Japan Tobacco, Altria and Imperial Brands have all lagged behind rivals such as PMI and British American Tobacco in expanding beyond traditional tobacco, with past efforts yielding mixed results.
"Imperial and to a lesser extent (Japan Tobacco) and Altria are in a tough strategic spot, without the financial firepower to properly compete with (PMI and BAT) as the nicotine industry transitions from legacy cigarettes," Callum Elliott, analyst at Bernstein, said in a note.
Last week, Imperial Brands, which makes Winston cigarettes, announced plans to cut up to 4,600 jobs, or nearly a fifth of its workforce.
Altria and Japan Tobacco already have ties, having launched a joint venture in 2022 to grow newer product lines.
Japan Tobacco has also been expanding its US tobacco business, particularly in cheaper labels that have been winning market share - a trend that has benefited Imperial's brands.
Under UK takeover rules, Altria has until December 24 to make a firm offer or walk away.

• Three operators of critical infrastructure were among those targeted, BACS said
• These included providers of electricity, water, and telecommunications, Swiss public broadcaster SRF said

FAST

BRUSSELS, Nov 26 : Chinese e-commerce platform Temu has committed to bringing several of its commercial practices in line with EU consumer protection laws, the European Commission said on Thursday.
"Temu's commitments concern a broad range of commercial practices that mislead consumers or unduly influence their purchasing decisions, including fake discounts, fake reviews, pressure selling, forced gamification, and missing and misleading information," the Commission said in a statement.
Temu, which is owned by PDD Holdings, said it would provide clearer and more accessible information for customer support, prices, environmental claims and checkout, and would make refunds easier. Temu also committed to ending forced gamification features, like spinning the wheel to access the marketplace, and pressure-selling messages, the Commission said.
A Temu spokesperson said the company was pleased to have reached a resolution.
"We appreciate the constructive engagement throughout the process and will continue to strengthen transparency and improve the shopping experience for consumers across Europe."
Countries will now monitor Temu's compliance with its commitments. Failing to comply could lead to fines of 4 per cent or more of Temu's annual turnover in the concerned member states.

Source: Reuters

PARIS, Nov 26 : FIFA said on Thursday it had been the victim of a criminal cyberattack that gave unauthorised access to personal and business information.
A person with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters that no files from the abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise project were accessed.
"FIFA can confirm that it has been the victim of a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information," a FIFA spokesperson told Reuters.
FIFA strongly condemned the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data, adding that such actions were "a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy".

FIFA President Gianni Infantino said in July that his organisation had scrapped plans to sell a stake in the World Cup to private investors following a widespread backlash.

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Nov 26 : Dutch consumer and digital rights groups asked a court on Thursday to halt sales of Meta AI-powered smart glasses in the Netherlands, arguing they violate European privacy laws by allowing wearers to film people without their knowledge.
While limited in scope to the Netherlands, a summary ruling in the civil suit against Meta at the Amsterdam District Court could set a precedent amid growing public backlash, venue bans and regulatory warnings across the world.
A decision is expected by December 24 at the latest.
The rights groups, which include the Netherlands' main consumer association Consumentenbond and Offlimits, which campaigns against online sex abuse, argued that the glasses developed by Meta and Ray-Ban owner EssilorLuxottica both violate privacy laws and force people to constantly worry in public places, with a chilling effect on society.

The plaintiffs want Meta to prevent its glasses from being used to record people without their knowledge, stop using recordings to train AI models and halt sales until Meta complies. They sought penalties of €100,000 ($109,600) per day per defendant for non-compliance, capped at €100 million.
Offlimits' lawyer Karlijn Han said the glasses were used for what she described in court as "creep shots." "Covert recordings are undoubtedly also being made during exams, in changing rooms, at swimming pools, in hotel rooms and hospitals, but also in playgrounds and on beaches," she said in opening remarks. "Each invasion of privacy is worse than the last."
META DENIES IMAGES ARE USED TO TRAIN AI
Meta's lawyer Bastiaan Kemp said the court should reject the suit. He said the measures demanded would harm legitimate users, damage Meta's competitive position and amount to a product recall without resolving concerns about similar devices.
“Providers of products cannot be held responsible for every instance of deliberate misuse,” he told the court. He said that a recording light on the frame makes it obvious when they are being used for recording.
And he denied allegations made by Consumentenbond's lawyer in court that Meta processes images recorded by the smart glasses in Europe or uses them to train AI models in violation of European law. Meta and manufacturing partner EssilorLuxottica sold more than 7 million smart glasses in 2025, around 80 per cent of the global market.
A lawyer for EssilorLuxottica argued that it neither processes nor has access to footage and that a sales ban would be disproportionate and ineffective given the availability of similar products from other manufacturers.
BACKLASH EXTENDS WORLDWIDE
From proposed restrictions in Australia and Norway to bans in courts across England, Wales and New York state, governments and judicial authorities are increasingly seeking to prevent covert recording and protect sensitive information. Cinema operators in the UK are also introducing restrictions over privacy and film piracy concerns.  
On Tuesday, Germany's national consumer federation announced legal action against Meta and Ray-Ban over alleged privacy violations, arguing that the glasses make it nearly impossible for consumers to comply with European data protection rules when using them in public.
The European Data Protection Board warned in October that smart glasses raised serious privacy concerns and called for stronger safeguards.
Dutch privacy regulator AP this month advised consumers to not buy smart glasses, saying they are unsafe for both users and bystanders. In October, Dutch retail chain Hans Anders suspended sales of Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium.
Meta also faces proposed class-action lawsuits in the United States over alleged improper sharing of private images gathered by the glasses.

items.title: ロシア、ウクライナが地中海やバルト海へ戦争拡大と非難
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ ２６日 ロイター] - ロシア大統領府のペスコフ報道官は２６日、ウクライナが対ロ戦争を地中海とバルト海に拡大しようとしていると非難し、極めて危険な動きだと警告した。

トランプ米大統領と北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のルッテ事務総長は２５日、米フロリダ州での会談後に共同声明を発表し、ウクライナでの戦争を拡大させる行動を避けるようロシアに求めた。ウクライナが最近、紛争地域から遠く離れたロシアの権益を攻撃したことを巡り、報復措置を慎重に検討するようロシアに警告したものとみられる。

ウクライナは２２日、リビアの港湾で水上無人艇（ドローン）を使ってロシア海軍のコルベット艦を撃沈した。前日にはフィンランド湾でロシア軍関連の貨物船をドローンで攻撃していた。

ペスコフ氏は電話会見で米・ＮＡＴＯの共同声明について「ウクライナ紛争の激化に関しては、ウクライナ政権が紛争の地理的範囲を拡大しようとしていることを指すようだ。われわれは地中海とバルト海でウクライナ政権によるテロ活動を目撃している」と述べた。

「これは沿岸諸国だけでなく、おそらくＮＡＴＯ内部でも懸念を引き起こさざるを得ない。むろん紛争の地理的拡大は誰も望まないだろう。ウクライナ政権による潜在的に極めて危険な行動だ」と語った。

HONG KONG, Nov 26 : Standard Chartered's cryptocurrency custody unit Zodia Custody suffered a security breach earlier this week that exposed some client and employee information, the unit's chief executive told Reuters on Thursday.
The breach, detected by Zodia on Monday, resulted in some client and staff data, including names and email addresses, being leaked, Zodia Custody CEO Richard Clark said in an emailed statement.
The company's London-listed shares were up 2.6 per cent on the day.
"Based on our investigation to date, there have been no unauthorised transactions," Clark said.

The incident is a setback for the Asia- and Africa-focused lender's digital asset ambitions, coming weeks after it increased its stake in Zodia to 100 per cent as it expands its cryptocurrency business amid growing mainstream adoption of digital assets.
Zodia on Monday took offline software that allows institutional clients' systems to connect directly to its platform after detecting what Clark described as attempts to probe its systems.
The service has since been restored, and affected clients and regulators have been notified, he added.
On Tuesday, Zodia determined that an unauthorised party had accessed "limited" client information, including organisation details and, for a small number of clients and employees, a business contact name and email address, Clark said.
The breach adds to a growing list of cybersecurity incidents affecting financial institutions as hackers deploy increasingly sophisticated tools, although it is not clear whether artificial intelligence played any role in this case.

items.title: 仏極右党首に新たな反ユダヤ疑惑報道、10代の頃のチャット巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パリ ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[パリ ２６日 ロイター] - 仏極右政党、国民連合（ＲＮ）のジョルダン・バルデラ党首（３１）は２６日、過去の反ユダヤ主義的なコメントを巡って新たな非難に直面した。同党首が１０代だった２０１３年にチャットで交わしたとされる新たな一連の記録が報じられた。

バルデラ氏を巡る最初の疑惑は、９月に調査報道メディア「メディアパート」によって伝えられた。同メディアは、同氏が数多くの反ユダヤ主義的かつ陰謀論的なコメントを行っていたと報じていた。

来年の大統領選挙を控え、ＲＮを事実上率いるマリーヌ・ルペン氏は世論調査で首位を走っており、同氏が当選した場合、バルデラ氏は首相に就任すると見込まれている。

メディアパートと仏紙ルモンドは２６日、チャットの情報源に再取材を行ったと報道。その情報源から提供された完全な記録によると、これらのチャットには反ユダヤ主義的かつ陰謀論的な内容が散見される。

ロイターはこれらの記録を独自に検証できていない。

ルモンドは、フェイスブックの親会社であるメタを通じてチャットの真正性を確認し、情報源の身元も確認したとしている。

バルデラ氏は「メディアパートとルモンドが私のものとしているチャット内容について、断固として否定することを改めて表明する」との声明を出し、自身が未成年だった頃の出来事を報じようとしている両メディアを批判。「これらの内容は、当時も今も、私の考えでも、価値観でも、信念でもない」と訴えた。

items.title: 英、原潜施設改修でバブコックと80億ポンド契約　即応態勢強化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sarah Young

[ロンドン ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sarah Young

[ロンドン ２６日 ロイター] - 英国は原子力潜水艦関連施設の改修に向け、防衛企業バブコックと８０億ポンド（１０４億８０００万ドル）の契約を結んだ。ストリーティング国防相は２６日、英国の「戦闘即応態勢」を整える取り組みの一環だと説明した。

政府は過去２年間、国防費の積み増しに必要な財源の確保に苦慮してきた。ストリーティング氏はその状況が変わりつつあるとし、先月発表された財務相の予算案で国防分野が「際立った勝者」になったと述べた。

声明で「われわれの原子力潜水艦は国家安全保障の礎だ」と強調した。「他省庁から財源を移すことになっても、核抑止力と英国の戦闘即応態勢の確立を優先する」とした。

ストリーティング氏は、政府が戦略予備役である退役軍人約１０万人にも連絡を取り、情報を最新の状態に更新させるとともに、戦争に備えるよう伝えたと明らかにした。

バーナム首相は、今回の潜水艦契約によりプリマス、クライド、ブリストルを中心に５５００人の新規雇用が生まれ、国内各地の成長を押し上げると述べた。

items.title: Settlers smash foundations of Palestinian family's homes in West Bank
items.summary: Militant Israeli settlers smashed the foundations of two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the West Bank on Thursday, after settler attacks prevented the family from returning to them in ...
items.body:
Settlers smash foundations of Palestinian family's homes in West Bank
Reuters | Updated: 26-11-2026 23:58 IST | Created: 26-11-2026 23:58 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Militant Israeli settlers smashed the foundations of two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the West Bank on Thursday, after settler attacks prevented the family from returning to them in defiance of an Israeli court order. Security cameras showed the settlers bringing a bulldozer to the hilltop two-storey houses on either side of a road in the village of Jaloud at around 1 a.m. and spending about an hour damaging the houses. The family said it had been forced out months ago.
In a visit to the area, Reuters reporters saw that the concrete foundations of the homes had been partially broken. "This latest escalation is a direct consequence of the lack of law enforcement and the sense of impunity enjoyed by the perpetrators," said Ghiath Nasser, a lawyer representing the owners of the houses in court.
The demolition follows a surge of settler violence in which settlers have encroached on Palestinian villages, with an average of 53 settler attacks per week since the start of 2026, according to UN figures. The Israeli military issued a statement condemning Thursday's attack as “a serious criminal act” and said it was investigating the incident. What appeared to be Israeli security forces were visible visiting the area around the homes.
In most cases, such incidents do not result in prosecution. According to Israeli rights group Yesh Din, 93.6% of investigations into settler violence cases are closed without indictments. “They want to demolish the houses so that we cannot return to them,” said Wael Tubasi, one of the owners of the homes. He said the deadline for the Israeli military to remove the settlers had passed, but Reuters reporters saw settlers in the area throughout the day.
The Israeli military said a closed military zone order was in effect in the area and it was illegal for settlers to enter. It said settlers dispersed after the military arrived. Israel occupied the West Bank after a 1967 war, and has built hundreds of settlements there. UN bodies, Palestinians and most countries view the settlements as illegal under international conventions, a stance Israel disputes, and as an obstacle to peace.
WATCHING THEIR HOMES FROM AFAR The Tubasi family now live in a small house in Jaloud, near the West Bank city of Nablus, with a direct view of the homes they were forced to flee.
For months they have seen settlers move freely through their homes, while living in a small dwelling behind the two houses. “Even though there is a court order, and the army is required to remove them from the area entirely, not just return us to our homes, it's still not being implemented,” said Tubasi.
In September, after the court order, the Israeli military escorted the family back to their houses. Ten minutes after they arrived, around 200 settlers attacked them, forcing the military and the family to retreat, family members said. The settlers then burned the houses and broke much of the furniture inside, they said, and since then they have been unable to return. “I'm forbidden from reaching my home, while the settlers have the right to remain inside. What rights are there?” said Aedah Tubasi, Wael’s mother.
In April, settlers built a tent near the Tubasi family's homes. They began attacking the family, set fire to their homes, cut their water and electricity, and blocked roads to the houses, the family said. After three months, settlers appeared at their door and told them they had an hour to leave or be killed "like the Dawabsheh family," Aedah quoted them as saying.
An 18-month-old child, his mother and father were killed when settlers set fire to the home of the Dawabsheh family in the West Bank village of Duma in 2015.

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

Malaysia wants priority over other lenders if it backs AirAsia

AirAsia is aiming to raise up to US$1 billion from international debt markets, as well as 700 million ringgit in local credit facilities.

FILE PHOTO: An AirAsia plane takes off at Kuala Lumpur International Airport Terminal 2 (KLIA2) in Sepang, Malaysia, September 18, 2026. REUTERS/Najjua Zulkefli/File Photo

26 Nov 2026 06:19PM

FAST

KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia will require AirAsia to give it priority over other lenders if the government agrees to provide support to the budget airline, the country's finance minister said on Thursday (Nov 26).
Officials have said they are assessing ways to provide support without risking public funds. Authorities are monitoring AirAsia's financial health as airlines around the world grapple with a jump in jet fuel prices linked to the Iran war.
AirAsia has said it was aiming to raise up to US$1 billion from international debt markets as well as 700 million ringgit in local credit facilities, with the fundraising expected to be completed between December and February.
Shares in the airline, which controls about 60 per cent of Malaysia's domestic aviation market and employs about 26,000 people, have lost about 72 per cent of their value this year. AirAsia posted a narrower loss in the third quarter, but warned of rising fuel costs as it works to boost liquidity.

Malaysia's Second Finance Minister Amir Hamzah Azizan told parliament that there has so far been no agreement or commitment to provide support to AirAsia, either in the form of loans, guarantees or public fund injections.
But if required, the government would look to safeguard public funds and ensure no disruptions to connectivity, he added.
"We want to ensure that public funds get the priority they deserve because we would be the saviours if we were to intervene," Amir Hamzah said.
The government would also look to strengthen oversight of AirAsia's board and management, Amir Hamzah said, citing a similar approach taken to assist debt-laden oil and gas services firm Vantris Energy.
"The government's priority is the interests of the nation and the people, not the interests of shareholders," he added.
The government's monitoring was only focused on AirAsia's domestic operations and not on its overseas arms or related businesses under its affiliate Capital A.
Malaysia last year approved a 1.1 billion ringgit (US$267 million) capital injection into Vantris through redeemable convertible loan stock, a move officials have described as a strategic ecosystem rescue rather than a bailout.
The global aviation industry is suffering its worst crisis since the COVID-19 pandemic as the conflict, which began at the end of February, disrupts operations, drives up fuel prices, and sends airlines' costs rocketing.
Norwegian airline Norse Atlantic suspended flights on Thursday and intends to file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure a short-term financing solution urgently.

Source: Reuters/nh

items.title: キーウに弾道ミサイル攻撃、7人負傷＝市長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２５日 ロイター] - ウクライナの首都キーウが夜間にロシアの弾道ミサイル攻撃を受け、７人が負傷し、ショッピングセンターと他の２棟の建物が被弾した。キーウのクリチコ市長が明らかにした。一方、ロシア国防省はキーウ市内のドローン（無人機）関連施設を攻撃したとしている。

キーウ全域で一連の激しい爆発音が響き渡り、２６日朝になっても大規模な火災が続き、空に黒煙が立ち上っていた。

クリチコ氏によると、ミサイルは市内を二分するドニプロ川の東岸にあるショッピングセンターと他の２棟の建物を直撃。そのうち１棟が甚大な被害を受けたという。負傷者のうち２人が重体だという。

 ロイターはこれらの発表を直ちに確認できなかった。

ウクライナ空軍によると、ロシアは夜間に弾道ミサイルに加え、１１３機の「シャヘド」型攻撃ドローンを発射した。暫定データによると、防空部隊が８７機のドローンを撃墜・無力化した。

items.title: 伊ウニクレディト、独コメルツ銀の監査役会刷新へ　当局承認完了
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Valentina Za

［ミラノ　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Valentina Za

［ミラノ　２６日　ロイター］ - イタリアの銀行大手ウニクレディトは２６日、ドイツのコメルツ銀行の経営権取得に必要な当局の承認手続きを完了したことを受け、コメルツ銀の監査役会に自社の代表を送り込む手続きに入った。コメルツ銀は、ウニクレディトが監査役会の株主代表１０人のうち９人の交代を求め、アンドレア・オルチェル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を監査役会議長に指名する意向だとした。

ウニクレディトによると、ポーランド金融監督庁（ＫＮＦ）の承認が規制上の最終段階だった。手続きは１２月７日までに完了する見通しだとしている。

ウニクレディトはコメルツ銀に対する戦略を実行するため、同行に新たな経営トップを送り込むとみられる。合併に先立ち両行の「すり合わせ」を行うため、少なくとも２０２８年まではドイツ部門のＨＶＢとは別組織としておく計画だ。

コメルツ銀行によると、現在の監査役会会長で、ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）元総裁のイェンス・ワイトマン氏の後任にはオルチェル氏が就く。

ウニクレディトの候補者リストには、同社の財務、デジタル、リスク管理の各部門トップと、新しい人事責任者が入っている。株主側から選ばれた監査役のうち留任させる予定なのは、英スタンダード・チャータードで最高情報責任者（ＣＩＯ）を務めたミヒャエル・ゴリツ氏だけだ。

コメルツ銀行によると、ウニクレディトは７人で構成する取締役会のメンバーの一部を退任させるよう監査役会に求めている。ただ、人数はまだ示していない。

ワイトマン氏は声明で「監査役会は、取締役会の新たな人事を進めるよう求めるウニクレディトの要請を検討する」と述べた。「現段階では、銀行の安定を確保し、顧客に注力することが重要だ」とした。
